title: A daily job digest that arrives on time
summary: Send each person the few new jobs that fit them, every morning, without flooding anyone.
context: Ragi Careers has 600,000 members in India, each with saved searches. New postings arrive all day from many sources. Members asked for one email at 8:00 in the morning, in place of a separate alert for every match.
Half the postings are repeats of something seen earlier in the week, reposted with a new date. Members who see the same role twice unsubscribe, and members who get an empty email complain too.
must_handle: Each member gets at most one digest a day, at about 8:00 their time.
A posting already sent to a member is not sent again, even if reposted.
A digest with nothing good in it is not sent.
A failed run can restart at 8:20 without sending anyone a second copy.
Saved searches can change up to the moment the digest is built.
show_in_answer: How a member's digest is put together, and when.
How repeats are recognised across sources.
How the 8:00 send is spread out and retried.
What you measure to know that a morning went well.
